title: Red Hat Security Advisory: pki-core:10.6 security update
description: A security vulnerability in the pki-core component of Red Hat Certificate System allows code execution via unsanitized profile content in certprofile-import. This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-76561 and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.6 with the pki-core:10.6 module. Red Hat has released an important security update to address this vulnerability.
